name: Eliphelet
overview: Eliphelet is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Adonikam. He is notably recorded as one who accompanied Ezra during the return from exile, as stated in Ezra 8:13. There is no tribal affiliation or additional personal notes provided for him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliphelet means 'G-d [El] is [my] deliverance.' This proper name reflects a trust in God's saving power, though it was not given directly by God according to the record in Ezra 8:13.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Eliphelet as a descendant of Adonikam, establishing a genealogical connection important for identifying his lineage. No other family relationships are documented beyond this descent.
scriptureSignificance: Eliphelet's significance lies in his participation in the group led by Ezra who returned to Jerusalem, marking him as part of the faithful remnant restoring Israel after the exile. His mention underscores the continuity of God's people through specific families, such as that of Adonikam, during this pivotal moment in biblical history.
